sectionAppendix.visualContinuity: Original Clinexa-derived shell and overview remain unchanged; new sections reuse soft panels, pastel graphics, compact Inter, and rounded controls.

legibility.supportingText: Darker slate and category-specific ink; section descriptions bind to --cs-muted.
legibility.libraryMobile: 12px titles / 1.6 line height; 10px metadata / 1.5 line height; 10px wrapping statuses.
legibility.calendar: 10px event titles; completed month events retain full opacity and add an accessible Published check SVG.

responsive.1000px: Library/calendar sidebars move below main content; stats become two columns; research panels stack.
responsive.700px: Two-column asset grid; seven-day week view scrolls horizontally.
responsive.560px: Existing bottom navigation and mobile layout; readable final library text rules retained.

behavior.library: List/grid, title/keyword search, type/status filters, date/title sorting, collection searches, visible-row select-all, session-only bulk review excluding published items.
behavior.export: Default Export uses filtered visible rows; selection Export uses selected records, including selections retained outside current filter.
behavior.calendar: Month/week/agenda, date navigation, Today, content-type filter, selectable day agenda, event detail dialog, date-prefilled creation.
behavior.composer: Shared native dialog; calendar prepopulates date, keyword action prepopulates title/keyword; save creates a local session record.
behavior.research: Five source keywords with search/lower-difficulty filter; AI baseline and source date; readiness unscored; fresh scans require connected workspace.

sectionAppendix.dataContract: Added sample records and schedules are illustrative. Research snapshots are historical. Decorative mini-charts are not performance history. No backend, persistence, content generation, or live publishing is configured.

narrative.overview: This system records the implemented Uplift AI dashboard in React and Vite. Its visual authority is the user's selected screen inside the Clinexa laptop reference, adapted to Uplift's content operations terminology. The cool lavender-to-mint canvas, soft white panels, compact Inter typography, purple icon rail, and pastel charts follow that selection; this is not a newly invented visual identity.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet tonal separation between the canvas and panels.
Compact text with large, steady metric numerals.
Rounded controls, slim SVG icons, and pastel data graphics.
A dense desktop overview that stacks into a mobile workspace.

rules.name: The Labeled Data Rule
rules.body: Pair chart colors and status dots with text; preserve the visible illustrative-data and snapshot labels.

rules.name: The Overlay Depth Rule
rules.body: Reserve substantial shadow and backdrop blur for content that floats over the workspace.

dos: **Do** preserve the user-selected Clinexa screen's quiet palette and dashboard hierarchy.
**Do** retain readable card titles and metadata when adapting density.
**Do** pair interactive chart marks with keyboard focus behavior and textual values.
**Do** distinguish historical workspace snapshots, illustrative charts, and session-only changes.
donts: **Don't** import the original Uplift website's layout or imagery into this reference-led dashboard.
**Don't** replace SVG and CSS data graphics with raster approximations.
**Don't** treat the smallest auxiliary annotations as the default text scale for new components.
**Don't** imply that a preview interaction publishes content or changes a live connection.
